title: Translation Assessment:
subtitle: An editorial assessment report for interested readers and publishers. Segment-level deviation analysis on an error typology adapted from Multidimensional Quality Metrics, the translation industry's standard framework, for an <expressive (literary) | informative (scientific, technical)> text, with a descriptive translation-studies profile of the translator.
_comment: stage is 'Pre-publication' (ends in decision, decisionBasis, publisherNote) or 'Published' (fill publication; ends in grade, gradeBasis, readerNote). textNotes: report-specific notes on the texts only (transcription, misprints, segmentation); everything general is on the Method page.
